fusions.name: Pin in the Glove
fusions.desc: Flicks a hidden pin that deals 4 damage, with a 15% chance to confuse the target for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Scattered Tacks
fusions.desc: Scatters pins around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Not Where I Was
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dulled by the Sting
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
